exposure_basis: Detention/penalty u/s 129 (200% of tax payable for taxable goods where owner comes forward, as amended w.e.f. 01.01.2022) on interception; penalty u/s 122 for transport without documents; reputational and supply-chain disruption.
corrective_action: Generate challan/EWB through ERP for all movement types.

title: Part-B updation and validity expiry
objective: Ensure Part-B (vehicle details) is updated and goods reach before EWB validity expires or validity is extended.
procedure:
1. Extract EWBs with Part-B missing or vehicle updates.
2. Compare validity end with actual delivery/GRN date of customer where available.
3. Identify expired EWBs without extension where goods were in transit.
expected_result: Part-B updated before movement; validity sufficient or extended.
exception_conditions: Part-A only EWBs used for movement; expired EWBs.
exposure_basis: Detention/penalty u/s 129 (200% of tax payable for taxable goods where owner comes forward, as amended w.e.f. 01.01.2022) on interception; penalty u/s 122 for transport without documents; reputational and supply-chain disruption.
corrective_action: Train transporters and monitor validity via alerts.

title: E-way bills for exports, SEZ supplies and imports from port
objective: Ensure EWBs are generated for movement to port/ICD for exports, to SEZ units, and from port/CFS to premises for imports, with correct transaction type.
procedure:
1. Map exports to EWBs showing ship-to as port and bill-to as foreign buyer (URP, State 96/Other Country).
2. Map imports (BOE) to EWBs for movement from port to place of business.
3. Map SEZ supplies to EWBs.
expected_result: EWBs exist for export, SEZ and import movements.
exception_conditions: Import consignments moved from port without EWB; export EWB with incorrect ship-to.
exposure_basis: Detention/penalty u/s 129 (200% of tax payable for taxable goods where owner comes forward, as amended w.e.f. 01.01.2022) on interception; penalty u/s 122 for transport without documents; reputational and supply-chain disruption.
corrective_action: Align logistics SOP for EWB on import/export legs.

title: E-way bill HSN, value and quantity consistency with invoice
objective: Verify EWB HSN, taxable value and quantity are consistent with the invoice, as mismatches result in detention and demands.
procedure:
1. Match EWB lines with invoice lines on HSN and quantity.
2. Flag HSN mismatches and value variances beyond tolerance.
3. For e-invoiced documents, ensure EWB generated from IRN to avoid re-keying.
expected_result: EWB and invoice data consistent.
exception_conditions: Different HSN on EWB vs invoice; quantity/value mismatch.
exposure_basis: Detention/penalty u/s 129 (200% of tax payable for taxable goods where owner comes forward, as amended w.e.f. 01.01.2022) on interception; penalty u/s 122 for transport without documents; reputational and supply-chain disruption.
corrective_action: Generate EWB from IRN/ERP integration rather than manual entry.

title: Export invoices vs shipping bills vs GSTR-1 Table 6A
objective: Reconcile export invoices in books with shipping bills on ICEGATE and Table 6A of GSTR-1 for value, date, port code and SB number.
procedure:
1. Extract export invoices from sales register and GSTR-1 Table 6A.
2. Download shipping bill data from ICEGATE (SB number, date, port code, invoice number, FOB, IGST).
3. Match invoice number, SB details, and values; recompute FOB vs invoice value variances and exchange rates.
4. Classify: no SB, SB not in 6A, value mismatch, IGST mismatch, SB date before invoice date.
expected_result: Complete three-way match supporting export status and refunds.
exception_conditions: Invoices without SB; Table 6A without SB/port code; IGST in 6A differs from SB.
exposure_basis: Where export not evidenced: IGST on supply + interest (s.50(1)) or LUT condition breach (Rule 96A); stuck IGST refunds (working capital).
corrective_action: Update 6A through Table 9A amendment, correct SB via Section 149 where allowed, and pursue refunds.

title: Export invoices reported without shipping bill or port code
objective: Detect export invoices in GSTR-1 Table 6A lacking SB number, SB date or port code.
procedure:
1. Filter Table 6A records with blank SB number/date/port code.
2. Locate the shipping bills and update details through amendment.
3. For exports with payment of IGST, verify refund status after correction.
expected_result: All 6A records include SB details.
exception_conditions: Blank SB details; port code invalid.
exposure_basis: IGST refund not processed; LUT export not evidenced.
corrective_action: Amend through Table 9A and include SB capture in post-shipment process.

title: ICEGATE transmission failures and IGST refund errors
objective: Identify shipping bills where IGST refund has not been processed due to transmission or validation errors and resolve them.
procedure:
1. Download ICEGATE IGST refund status for all SBs with payment of IGST.
2. Classify pending items by error type (invoice mismatch, EGM not filed, GSTR-3B IGST short, bank account not validated, record not transmitted).
3. Verify GSTR-3B Table 3.1(b) IGST paid covers export IGST in 6A.
4. Track resolution actions and ageing.
expected_result: All IGST refunds processed or errors resolved promptly.
exception_conditions: Refunds pending due to unresolved errors; transmission failures for whole periods.
exposure_basis: Blocked IGST refund (working capital); potential loss if limitation issues arise.
corrective_action: Correct mismatches, file EGM corrections via shipping line, and approach customs refund cell with documents.

title: LUT validity, ARN and reference on invoices
objective: Ensure a valid LUT is in force for the financial year before exports/SEZ supplies without payment of IGST, and its ARN is referenced correctly.
procedure:
1. Obtain LUT acknowledgement (RFD-11) for each financial year and GSTIN.
2. Compare LUT filing date with the date of first zero-rated supply without tax.
3. Check invoices bear the declaration and correct LUT ARN.
4. Identify supplies made before LUT filing or under an expired LUT.
expected_result: Valid LUT for all zero-rated supplies without tax, correctly referenced.
exception_conditions: LUT filed late; wrong ARN on invoices; LUT absent for one GSTIN.
exposure_basis: Exports without valid LUT may be treated as requiring IGST payment + interest; condonation of procedural lapse often possible but uncertain.
corrective_action: File LUT at start of FY, correct ARN references, and document substantive compliance for delayed LUT.

title: Rule 96A three-month export condition for goods under LUT
objective: Ensure goods supplied under LUT are exported within three months of invoice date (or extended period), else IGST with interest is paid.
procedure:
1. Compute days between export invoice date and shipping bill/let export date.
2. Flag cases exceeding three months without extension.
3. Check whether IGST with interest was paid for flagged cases.
4. Identify invoices with no SB at all beyond three months.
expected_result: All LUT exports shipped within three months.
exception_conditions: Invoices raised in advance of shipment by more than three months; unshipped invoices.
exposure_basis: IGST on invoice value + interest u/s 50(1) from invoice date; refundable later on export but interest cost remains.
corrective_action: Pay IGST with interest for defaulted cases and claim refund on subsequent export; align invoicing with shipment date.

title: Export of services conditions and intermediary risk
objective: Verify that services treated as export meet all five conditions of IGST Section 2(6) and are not intermediary services or supplies to own establishments.
procedure:
1. List export of service invoices and customer agreements.
2. Determine place of supply under IGST Section 13 (default, performance-based, intermediary, etc.).
3. Verify foreign exchange realisation (FIRC/e-BRC) within one year under LUT.
4. Evaluate intermediary characterisation (arranging/facilitating supplies between others) and supply to establishments of the same entity outside India.
5. Check for services performed on goods temporarily imported (performance-based).
expected_result: All export of services satisfy Section 2(6) and POS outside India.
exception_conditions: Intermediary arrangements treated as exports; realisation in INR without RBI permission; customer is own branch abroad.
exposure_basis: IGST on invoice value + interest u/s 50(1); refund recoveries.
corrective_action: Pay IGST where conditions fail, restructure contracts, and document POS analysis.

title: Exports with payment of IGST — eligibility and restrictions
objective: Verify eligibility for the IGST-paid export route and compliance with associated restrictions, including Rule 96(10) for the period it was in force.
procedure:
1. Identify exports with payment of IGST and refunds received.
2. Check whether inputs were procured under concessional schemes (Advance Authorisation, EOU, deemed export) that restricted IGST refund under Rule 96(10) during its operation (it was omitted by notification in October 2024).
3. Verify refund received matches IGST paid and was not double-claimed via LUT ITC refund route.
expected_result: IGST refunds claimed only where eligible.
exception_conditions: IGST refund with concessional-input procurement during restricted period; double refund.
exposure_basis: Recovery of refund + interest; penalty.
corrective_action: Evaluate repayment with interest or contest, considering judicial developments and omission of Rule 96(10).

title: Refund of unutilised ITC on zero-rated supplies under LUT
objective: Verify RFD-01 claims for zero-rated supplies without tax are computed under Rule 89(4), filed within two years, and supported.
procedure:
1. Obtain all refund applications, deficiency memos and orders (RFD-01 to RFD-06).
2. Recompute net ITC and zero-rated turnover (including the value-cap for goods per Rule 89(4)).
3. Check relevant dates and two-year limitation for unfiled periods.
4. Verify ITC used in computation is supported by GSTR-2B.
expected_result: Refunds claimed fully and on time; computations correct.
exception_conditions: Unclaimed refund periods near limitation; ineligible ITC included; turnover definitions inconsistent.
exposure_basis: Lost refund (time-barred); recovery of excess refund + interest.
corrective_action: File pending claims, correct computation, and track limitation dates.

title: Non-realisation of export proceeds
objective: Identify export receivables not realised within prescribed time, with consequences for export of services status, LUT conditions and refunds.
procedure:
1. Obtain export receivables ageing with e-BRC/FIRC status.
2. Flag service exports outstanding beyond one year (or extended period) under LUT.
3. Flag goods exports with refunds where realisation is pending beyond RBI timelines.
4. Check write-offs and RBI approvals.
expected_result: Export proceeds realised within prescribed periods.
exception_conditions: Old unrealised receivables; write-offs without RBI approval.
exposure_basis: IGST with interest on service exports where realisation fails; refund recovery for goods exports.
corrective_action: Pursue realisation or pay tax with interest; obtain RBI extension/write-off approvals.

title: Supplies to merchant exporters at concessional rate
objective: Verify conditions for concessional rate supplies to merchant exporters (and procurement by the company as merchant exporter) are satisfied.
procedure:
1. Identify concessional-rate supplies/purchases.
2. Verify export within 90 days, EPC registration, direct movement to port/registered warehouse, and documentation trail (SB copy, EGM).
3. Identify cases where export not evidenced.
expected_result: All conditions satisfied.
exception_conditions: Export beyond 90 days; goods moved to merchant's own premises.
exposure_basis: Differential tax (normal rate minus concessional rate) + interest u/s 50(1).
corrective_action: Pay differential tax with interest for non-compliant cases; enforce documentation SOP.

title: Amendments to shipping bills and Table 9A
objective: Ensure corrections to export data are carried out in both customs (Section 149) and GST (Table 9A) systems consistently.
procedure:
1. List all shipping bill amendments and GSTR-1 Table 9A amendments.
2. Match them and identify one-sided corrections.
3. Verify time limits for GSTR-1 amendments.
expected_result: Consistent amendments.
exception_conditions: SB amended but 6A not; 9A amendments without SB support.
exposure_basis: Refund delays; data mismatches leading to queries.
corrective_action: Coordinate customs broker and GST teams for joint corrections.

title: Supplies to SEZ units/developers — zero-rating and endorsement
objective: Ensure supplies to SEZ are treated as inter-State zero-rated supplies under LUT or with IGST, supported by SEZ endorsement for authorised operations.
procedure:
1. Identify customers that are SEZ units/developers from customer master and GSTIN status.
2. Verify invoices: IGST charged (WP) or LUT declaration (WOP); no CGST/SGST.
3. Obtain endorsements by SEZ authorised officer confirming receipt for authorised operations.
4. Verify reporting in GSTR-1 SEZWP/SEZWOP tables.
expected_result: All SEZ supplies zero-rated with endorsements.
exception_conditions: CGST/SGST charged to SEZ; endorsement missing; supply for non-authorised operations.
exposure_basis: Without endorsement, refund denied and zero-rating challenged → IGST + interest u/s 50(1).
corrective_action: Obtain endorsements, correct tax treatment, and add SEZ flag in customer master.

title: SEZ refund claims and endorsement completeness
objective: Ensure refund claims for SEZ supplies are filed within two years with endorsed invoices and correct computation.
procedure:
1. List SEZ supplies by month and refunds claimed.
2. Verify endorsement for each invoice included in claims.
3. Check limitation dates for unclaimed periods.
expected_result: Timely and fully supported refunds.
exception_conditions: Unclaimed periods near limitation; claims without endorsements.
exposure_basis: Lost refund; working capital cost.
corrective_action: File pending claims and track endorsements monthly.

title: Sale of goods while in FTWZ or customs warehouse (Schedule III para 8(a))
objective: Ensure transfers of title in warehoused goods before home clearance are treated as non-supply and that related ITC and reporting are aligned.
procedure:
1. Identify sales of goods while stored in FTWZ/bonded warehouse (high-sea/in-bond sales).
2. Confirm no GST charged and that the buyer files the into-bond/ex-bond BOE.
3. Report value as non-GST supply in GSTR-3B/GSTR-9 as applicable and include in Rule 42 exempt turnover as required by law (value of Schedule III para 8(a) supplies is specifically considered for reversal).
4. Verify ITC reversal on common inputs.
expected_result: Correct non-supply treatment with consistent ITC reversal.
exception_conditions: GST charged on warehoused sales; ITC reversal ignored.
exposure_basis: ITC reversal + interest; refund issues for GST wrongly charged (unjust enrichment).
corrective_action: Adjust reporting, reverse ITC, and train sales on warehoused sale documentation.

title: IGST credit on BOE for DTA clearance from FTWZ
objective: Ensure ITC is claimed only on IGST actually paid on bills of entry for clearance from FTWZ to DTA, and not on into-FTWZ or nil-duty BOEs.
procedure:
1. Classify BOEs by type (home consumption, into-bond/warehousing, ex-bond, SEZ/FTWZ DTA clearance).
2. Flag ITC claimed on BOEs where IGST paid is nil or where IGST is shown as bonded/ foregone.
3. Verify the importer name/GSTIN on BOE is the claimant.
4. Match ITC claimed with IGST on BOE and IMPG/IMPGSEZ in GSTR-2B.
expected_result: ITC equals IGST paid on eligible BOEs in the claimant's name.
exception_conditions: ITC on nil-duty or into-FTWZ BOEs; ITC claimed on BOE of FTWZ unit/other importer.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A.
corrective_action: Reverse ineligible ITC with interest and implement BOE-type based ITC rules.

title: Deemed export supplies and refunds
objective: Verify deemed export supplies meet Notification 48/2017-CT conditions and refund claims are correctly made by supplier or recipient.
procedure:
1. Identify supplies against Advance Authorisation/EPCG and to EOUs.
2. Verify documentation (authorisation endorsements, recipient declarations, prior intimation as applicable).
3. Verify tax charged and refund claims, ensuring recipient has not availed ITC where supplier claims refund.
expected_result: Compliant deemed export transactions with correct refund route.
exception_conditions: Missing documentation; double benefit.
exposure_basis: Refund rejection or recovery + interest.
corrective_action: Complete documentation and coordinate refund claims with counterparties.

title: Services to SEZ units including local services
objective: Ensure services supplied to SEZ units (including hotel, catering, events, maintenance at SEZ premises) are treated correctly as zero-rated where for authorised operations.
procedure:
1. Identify service invoices to SEZ GSTINs.
2. Verify zero-rating and authorised operations list from SEZ unit.
3. Verify IGST (not CGST/SGST) where supplied with payment of tax.
expected_result: Correct zero-rated treatment.
exception_conditions: CGST/SGST charged on services to SEZ; no authorised operations evidence.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Correct invoices and obtain endorsements.

title: IGST on BOE not reflected in GSTR-2B (IMPG/IMPGSEZ)
objective: Ensure ITC on imports is claimed on BOEs reflected in GSTR-2B and identify BOEs missing from 2B.
procedure:
1. Download BOEs from ICEGATE for the importer's IEC/GSTIN.
2. Match BOE number/date/IGST with GSTR-2B IMPG/IMPGSEZ sections.
3. Identify BOEs not in 2B (GSTIN not mentioned on BOE, amendment pending) and ITC claimed on them.
4. Track claims against Section 16(4) time limit.
expected_result: All import ITC supported by 2B; missing BOEs resolved.
exception_conditions: BOE with wrong GSTIN; ITC claimed without 2B reflection; BOE IGST unclaimed.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A. Unclaimed import IGST is a lost-credit opportunity.
corrective_action: Amend BOE GSTIN through customs, claim missed ITC within time, reverse unsupported claims.

title: Import purchase register vs bills of entry
objective: Reconcile imports recorded in books with BOEs for value, duty and IGST to detect unrecorded imports or mis-posted duties.
procedure:
1. Extract import purchase entries and customs duty ledgers.
2. Match each BOE with the purchase entry (invoice, assessable value, BCD, SWS, IGST).
3. Identify BOEs not in books and books entries without BOE.
4. Verify customs duty posted to inventory cost/expense and IGST to ITC.
expected_result: All BOEs accounted with correct duty and IGST bifurcation.
exception_conditions: BOEs missing in books; IGST expensed; BCD claimed as ITC.
exposure_basis: Lost ITC or ineligible ITC (BCD) + interest; inventory valuation errors.
corrective_action: Correct postings and claim/reverse ITC accordingly.

title: ITC claimed on nil-duty, FTWZ or warehousing bills of entry
objective: Prevent ITC on BOEs where no IGST was actually paid (into-bond, FTWZ entry, exemption/EOU, MOOWR deferment).
procedure:
1. Filter BOEs with IGST paid = 0 or BOE type warehousing/into-bond.
2. Match ITC claimed against these BOEs.
3. Confirm ITC claimed only on ex-bond BOEs where IGST was paid.
expected_result: No ITC on nil-duty BOEs.
exception_conditions: ITC on into-bond/FTWZ BOEs; ITC on exempted imports.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A.
corrective_action: Reverse ITC with interest and add BOE type checks.

title: Customs duty paid under protest — tracking and refund limitation
objective: Ensure duties paid under protest are documented as such and tracked so that refund rights are protected and the GST ITC on associated IGST is appropriately handled.
procedure:
1. Identify duty payments under protest (letters of protest, re-assessment disputes).
2. Verify protest letters were filed contemporaneously and acknowledged.
3. Track appeals and outcomes; compute refund claims due upon favourable orders.
4. Ensure accounting treatment (recoverable vs expensed) and disclosure as contingent asset/liability.
expected_result: Protest payments documented with refund tracking.
exception_conditions: Protest not recorded; refund claims not filed after favourable orders.
exposure_basis: Loss of refund if protest not documented (one-year limitation applies); contingent liabilities for disputes.
corrective_action: Maintain a protest register and file refunds promptly after final orders.

title: Provisional assessment and finalisation of bills of entry
objective: Track provisionally assessed BOEs, differential duty/IGST on finalisation and corresponding ITC.
procedure:
1. List BOEs under provisional assessment with bonds/securities.
2. Track finalisation status and differential duty or refund.
3. Ensure differential IGST paid is claimed as ITC on the appropriate document.
expected_result: Finalisation tracked; ITC on differential IGST claimed.
exception_conditions: Long-pending provisional assessments; ITC on differential IGST missed.
exposure_basis: Differential duty + interest u/s 18/28AA; lost ITC opportunity.
corrective_action: Follow up finalisation and claim ITC.

title: Valuation of related-party imports
objective: Ensure related-party import values are accepted by customs and consistent with transfer pricing adjustments, including impact on IGST.
procedure:
1. Identify related-party suppliers and related import volumes.
2. Review customs valuation findings/orders and any loading.
3. Identify transfer pricing true-ups (year-end adjustments) and assess customs/IGST consequences.
4. Assess royalties/licence fees related to imported goods for inclusion in value.
expected_result: Related-party values accepted with TP adjustments evaluated.
exception_conditions: TP upward adjustments without customs evaluation; royalties not added.
exposure_basis: Differential duty + IGST + interest u/s 28AA; penalties.
corrective_action: Evaluate voluntary payment of differential duty and align TP with customs.

title: Segregation of BCD, SWS and IGST in accounting
objective: Ensure only IGST (and compensation cess where applicable) on imports is taken as ITC while BCD and SWS are capitalised/expensed.
procedure:
1. Map duty components per BOE to GL postings.
2. Identify BCD/SWS posted to GST input accounts.
3. Verify IGST posted to GST input matches BOE IGST.
expected_result: Correct segregation.
exception_conditions: BCD/SWS posted as ITC; IGST capitalised.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A.
corrective_action: Correct postings and ITC claims.

title: Manufacturing and other operations in warehouse (Section 65)
objective: Ensure MOOWR operations comply with customs conditions and GST treatment on clearances is correct.
procedure:
1. Obtain MOOWR licence and permission.
2. Reconcile warehoused imported inputs and capital goods with consumption and clearances.
3. Verify duty payment on DTA clearances and export documentation for exports.
4. Verify GST on supplies of finished goods cleared to DTA.
expected_result: Inventory reconciled; duties paid on DTA clearances.
exception_conditions: Unaccounted warehoused goods; clearances without duty.
exposure_basis: Customs duty + interest; GST on supplies.
corrective_action: Reconcile, pay duty with interest where due, and strengthen warehouse accounting.

title: ITC-04 filing and reconciliation with stock records
objective: Ensure ITC-04 is filed for the prescribed periods and reconciles with challans and stock lying with job workers.
procedure:
1. Obtain ITC-04 filings and challan registers for the period.
2. Reconcile quantities sent, received back, supplied directly from job worker premises and closing stock at job workers.
3. Match challans with EWBs.
4. Verify filing frequency (half-yearly/annual by AATO) and timeliness.
expected_result: ITC-04 complete, timely and reconciled.
exception_conditions: Unfiled ITC-04; unreconciled quantities; challans without EWB.
exposure_basis: Deemed supply exposure for unreturned goods (see K-JW-002); general penalty u/s 125.
corrective_action: File pending ITC-04 and reconcile with job workers quarterly.

title: Inputs and capital goods not returned within one/three years
objective: Identify inputs not returned within one year and capital goods within three years from job workers, which are deemed supplied on the date of dispatch.
procedure:
1. Age challan-wise outstanding quantities at job workers.
2. Flag inputs beyond one year and capital goods beyond three years (excluding moulds, dies, jigs, fixtures, tools).
3. Verify invoice raised and tax paid with interest from the original dispatch date.
4. Verify any extension obtained.
expected_result: No overdue goods without tax compliance.
exception_conditions: Overdue goods at job worker without deemed supply invoice.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings. Interest runs from the original date of dispatch.
corrective_action: Raise invoices for deemed supply with tax and interest and retrieve/reconcile goods.

title: Delivery challans for movement to and from job workers
objective: Ensure all job work movements are accompanied by challans with prescribed particulars.
procedure:
1. Sample job work dispatches and receipts.
2. Verify challans contain prescribed particulars and serial numbers.
3. Verify EWB coverage for inter-State movements and above-threshold intra-State movements.
expected_result: Challans and EWBs for all movements.
exception_conditions: Movements on informal gate passes.
exposure_basis: Detention/penalty in transit; deemed supply challenge.
corrective_action: System-generate challans with EWB integration.

title: Job work charges, rates and waste/scrap
objective: Verify GST rate on job work services received/supplied and treatment of waste and scrap generated at job worker premises.
procedure:
1. Identify job work service invoices and applicable rate entries (based on goods and ownership).
2. Verify rate charged against notification entries.
3. Trace waste/scrap at job worker: who supplied, tax paid, and stock accounting.
expected_result: Correct rates and scrap compliance.
exception_conditions: Wrong rate on job work; scrap sold by job worker without tax.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Correct rate application and document scrap treatment.

title: ITC on goods lost, stolen, destroyed or written off
objective: Ensure ITC is reversed on inputs/finished goods written off, destroyed, lost or stolen, including inventory shortages identified on physical verification.
procedure:
1. Extract inventory write-off, obsolescence, physical verification shortage and insurance claim ledgers.
2. Distinguish normal process loss (no reversal) from write-off/destruction (reversal).
3. Compute ITC attributable (input-level for finished goods) and verify reversal in GSTR-3B.
expected_result: ITC reversed for write-offs and losses.
exception_conditions: Write-offs booked without ITC reversal; provisions vs actual write-off confusion.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A.
corrective_action: Reverse ITC with interest where utilised and link inventory write-off workflow to GST reversal.

title: Inverted duty structure refund eligibility and computation
objective: Identify and claim refunds of accumulated ITC due to inverted rate structure within limitation and in line with Rule 89(5).
procedure:
1. Compare input and output rates by product line.
2. Compute refund under Rule 89(5) (inputs only, excluding input services and capital goods).
3. Check exclusions notified for certain goods.
4. Track two-year limitation from the due date of the return for the period.
expected_result: Eligible refunds claimed timely.
exception_conditions: Accumulated credit not claimed; computation including services.
exposure_basis: Lost refund (opportunity); recovery for excess refunds + interest.
corrective_action: File refunds and monitor accumulation.

title: Sale or transfer of fixed assets on which ITC was taken
objective: Ensure tax is paid on disposal of capital goods at the higher of tax on transaction value or ITC taken less 5 percentage points per quarter.
procedure:
1. Extract asset deletions from the fixed asset register with dates, sale proceeds and original ITC.
2. Compute ITC attributable to remaining life (ITC less 5 percentage points per quarter or part since invoice date).
3. Compute tax on transaction value; determine the higher amount.
4. Verify invoice issued and amount paid; for transfers without consideration, check Schedule I para 1.
expected_result: Tax paid at the higher of the two amounts for every disposal.
exception_conditions: Asset sales without invoice; tax paid only on transaction value when ITC-based amount is higher; inter-unit asset transfers untaxed.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Pay differential with interest and integrate disposal workflow with GST computation.

title: Scrapping and write-off of capital goods
objective: Ensure capital goods sold as scrap are taxed under Section 18(6) and capital goods written off/destroyed are evaluated for ITC reversal.
procedure:
1. Identify assets scrapped or written off during the period.
2. Trace scrap sale invoices and tax paid; apply Section 18(6) computation (with transaction-value option for refractory bricks, moulds and dies, jigs and fixtures sold as scrap).
3. For assets written off without sale, assess ITC reversal position.
expected_result: Scrap sales taxed correctly; write-offs evaluated.
exception_conditions: Scrap sales booked to miscellaneous income without tax.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Pay tax with interest and document position on write-offs.

title: Blocked ITC on capital goods (immovable property, motor vehicles)
objective: Ensure ITC is not claimed on capital goods blocked under Section 17(5), particularly civil works, buildings and passenger vehicles.
procedure:
1. Extract capitalisations with ITC claimed by asset class.
2. Flag buildings, civil works, furniture fixed to building, and motor vehicles.
3. Evaluate plant and machinery exceptions (foundations and structural supports for machinery) and functionality arguments considering the retrospective amendment.
4. Verify CWIP ITC claims.
expected_result: No blocked ITC on capital goods.
exception_conditions: ITC on building construction, passenger cars, or CWIP civil works.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A.
evidence_required: Technical notes on plant and machinery
corrective_action: Reverse blocked ITC with interest and set asset-class ITC rules.

title: Depreciation claimed on GST component of capital goods
objective: Ensure ITC is not claimed where the tax component has been capitalised and depreciated under the Income-tax Act.
procedure:
1. Compare GST on capital goods invoices with ITC claimed and capitalised amounts.
2. Identify assets where GST was capitalised and ITC also claimed.
3. Coordinate with income-tax depreciation schedule.
expected_result: No dual benefit.
exception_conditions: GST included in asset cost and also claimed as ITC.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A.
corrective_action: Reverse ITC or correct capitalisation.

title: Common capital goods used for exempt supplies (Rule 43)
objective: Verify Rule 43 reversal on common capital goods over their 60-month life.
procedure:
1. Identify capital goods used commonly for taxable and exempt supplies.
2. Recompute monthly reversal based on exempt turnover ratio.
3. Verify reporting in GSTR-3B.
expected_result: Rule 43 reversals computed and reported.
exception_conditions: No Rule 43 reversal despite exempt supplies.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A.
corrective_action: Reverse with interest and automate monthly computation.

title: Capital goods sent to job workers or transferred between GSTINs
objective: Ensure capital goods moved to job workers are returned within three years and inter-GSTIN transfers are taxed as supplies between distinct persons.
procedure:
1. Identify asset location changes and transfers in the FAR.
2. Verify invoices for transfers across GSTINs (valued per Rule 28 and subject to Section 18(6) comparison as applicable).
3. Verify challans and ITC-04 for capital goods at job workers and return within three years.
expected_result: Compliant movements and transfers.
exception_conditions: Inter-State asset transfers on challan; capital goods at job workers beyond three years.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Invoice transfers and regularise job work capital goods.

title: Idle balance in electronic cash ledger
objective: Identify idle or misallocated balances in the electronic cash ledger and optimise through utilisation, PMT-09 transfer or refund.
procedure:
1. Download electronic cash ledger balances by major/minor head for each GSTIN.
2. Identify balances idle for more than a defined period and balances in wrong heads (e.g., interest/penalty heads, wrong State tax head).
3. Evaluate PMT-09 transfers between heads/distinct GSTINs (where permitted) or refund through RFD-01.
4. Check for challans paid but not credited (CIN issues).
expected_result: Minimal idle balances; misallocations corrected.
exception_conditions: Large idle balances; balances in interest/penalty heads not utilisable; unclaimed excess.
exposure_basis: Working capital blocked (H bucket: cash transfer/refund opportunity).
corrective_action: Transfer via PMT-09, utilise in next return, or claim refund.

title: Negative or abnormal ITC balances in books vs electronic credit ledger
objective: Reconcile GST input ledgers in books with the electronic credit ledger to detect negative balances, unreconciled differences and unbooked reversals.
procedure:
1. Extract head-wise GST input and output ledgers from books by GSTIN and month.
2. Compare closing balances with the electronic credit ledger.
3. Flag negative input ledger balances (indicating excess utilisation or wrong postings) and differences beyond tolerance.
4. Analyse root causes: reversals not booked, ITC claimed but not in books, set-off entries incorrect.
expected_result: Book balances reconcile with the electronic credit ledger.
exception_conditions: Negative input ledger balances; persistent unexplained differences.
exposure_basis: Indicator of excess ITC claims or unrecorded liabilities; quantified via C-ITC-001.
corrective_action: Rectify postings and align monthly set-off journals with GSTR-3B.

title: Order of ITC utilisation (Section 49A / Rule 88A)
objective: Verify that ITC is utilised in the prescribed order and that cross-utilisation of CGST and SGST credit does not occur.
procedure:
1. Extract GSTR-3B Table 6.1 set-off details for each month.
2. Verify IGST credit used first for IGST and then CGST/SGST.
3. Check no CGST credit used for SGST liability and vice versa.
expected_result: Utilisation in prescribed order.
exception_conditions: Manual utilisation errors leading to excess cash payment in one head and credit build-up in another.
exposure_basis: Cash flow inefficiency; head-wise imbalance across Centre/State.
corrective_action: Use system-recommended utilisation and monitor head-wise balances.

title: Rule 86B 1% cash payment restriction
objective: Ensure taxpayers with taxable supplies exceeding Rs 50 lakh per month pay at least 1% of output tax in cash unless an exception applies.
procedure:
1. Identify months where taxable supply (excluding exempt and zero-rated) exceeded Rs 50 lakh.
2. Check cash payment proportion of output tax.
3. Document applicable exceptions (income-tax paid above threshold, refunds received, cumulative cash payment, PSU).
expected_result: Compliance or documented exception each month.
exception_conditions: Full liability discharged through ITC without exception.
exposure_basis: Shortfall payable in cash + interest; GSTR-1 blocking under Rule 59(6).
corrective_action: Pay shortfall in cash and maintain exception documentation.

title: Blocking of electronic credit ledger under Rule 86A
objective: Identify any blocking of the electronic credit ledger and ensure timely representation and tracking of the one-year limit.
procedure:
1. Review the credit ledger for negative blocked balances and portal notices.
2. Obtain reasons for blocking and evaluate documentary defence (receipt of goods, supplier existence, payment).
3. Track date of blocking and statutory one-year lapse.
expected_result: No blocking, or blocking contested with documentation.
exception_conditions: Blocked credit unaddressed; blocking beyond one year not auto-released.
exposure_basis: Blocked ITC (working capital) and potential demand of ITC with interest and penalty.
corrective_action: File representation with evidence and follow up for unblocking.

title: GST payable ledgers vs electronic liability register
objective: Reconcile output tax ledgers in books with the electronic liability register and identify unpaid demands and outstanding liabilities.
procedure:
1. Download electronic liability register Part I and Part II (demands).
2. Compare with output tax and provisions in books.
3. Identify confirmed demands not recorded or paid, and DRC-03 payments not linked to demands.
expected_result: Books reflect all liabilities; register shows no unexplained outstanding.
exception_conditions: Outstanding demands not recorded; DRC-03 not adjusted against demand (DRC-03A pending).
exposure_basis: Recovery proceedings and interest on unpaid demands.
corrective_action: Record and settle or stay liabilities; link payments to demands.

title: GSTR-9 consistency with books, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B
objective: Ensure the annual return correctly reflects outward supplies, ITC and tax paid, reconciling with books and periodic returns.
procedure:
1. Compare GSTR-9 Table 4/5 with GSTR-1 and books.
2. Compare Table 6 ITC with GSTR-3B and books.
3. Compare Table 9 tax paid with GSTR-3B and DRC-03.
4. Identify unexplained differences and verify additional liability paid via DRC-03.
expected_result: GSTR-9 reconciles with source data.
exception_conditions: Differences without explanation; additional liability not paid.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Pay additional liability and maintain reconciliation workpapers.

title: GSTR-9 Table 8 — ITC per GSTR-2B vs ITC availed
objective: Analyse differences between ITC available as per 2B/2A and ITC availed for the year, including credit lapsing.
procedure:
1. Compare Table 8A (auto) with 8B and 8C.
2. Explain 8D differences (ineligible, timing, not booked).
3. Identify credit available but not availed that lapses.
expected_result: Differences explained.
exception_conditions: Large unexplained 8D differences; eligible credit lapsing.
exposure_basis: Lapsed ITC (lost opportunity); scrutiny queries on excess claims.
corrective_action: Document and claim eligible credit within time.

title: GSTR-9C turnover and tax reconciliation
objective: Ensure turnover per audited financial statements reconciles with GSTR-9 and unreconciled differences are explained or paid.
procedure:
1. Reconcile turnover per audited financials to GSTR-9 (unbilled revenue, credit notes, deemed supplies, Schedule I supplies, non-GST income).
2. Reconcile taxable value and tax by rate.
3. Identify additional liability and verify payment.
expected_result: All reconciling items explained.
exception_conditions: Unexplained differences; additional liability not paid.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Pay additional liability and refine revenue-to-GST mapping.

title: Additional liability identified in annual return paid via DRC-03
objective: Verify that liabilities identified during annual reconciliation are paid through DRC-03 with interest.
procedure:
1. List DRC-03 payments and reasons.
2. Map to annual return differences.
3. Verify interest computation and payment.
expected_result: All identified liabilities paid with interest.
exception_conditions: DRC-03 without interest; differences unpaid.
exposure_basis: Interest u/s 50(1) on delayed payment; penalty if detected in proceedings.
corrective_action: Pay interest shortfall.

title: Prior-year transactions reported in subsequent year returns
objective: Verify that transactions of the year declared in the next year's returns (up to the cut-off) are correctly disclosed in GSTR-9 Tables 10-14.
procedure:
1. Identify supplies, credit notes and ITC of the year reported between April and the cut-off of the following year.
2. Verify disclosure in Tables 10-14 and interest paid.
expected_result: Correct disclosure.
exception_conditions: Next-year amendments not disclosed; ITC beyond cut-off.
exposure_basis: Reporting inconsistencies leading to demands; interest.
corrective_action: Correct disclosures in GSTR-9.

title: HSN summary in GSTR-1 Table 12 and GSTR-9 Table 17/18
objective: Ensure HSN-wise summary is reported with the required digits and reconciles with invoices.
procedure:
1. Compare Table 12 HSN summary with sales register by HSN and rate.
2. Check digit compliance by AATO.
3. Compare annual HSN summary with GSTR-9 Table 17.
expected_result: Consistent HSN reporting.
exception_conditions: HSN mismatch; insufficient digits.
exposure_basis: General penalty; mismatches triggering scrutiny.
corrective_action: Correct item master HSN and reporting.

title: Interest u/s 50(1) on delayed payment of tax
objective: Recompute interest on tax paid late (net cash basis for delayed returns) and verify payment.
procedure:
1. Compile GSTR-3B filing dates and cash debits by period.
2. Compute interest @ 18% p.a. on cash portion for days of delay (net tax liability proviso).
3. Compute interest on liabilities of earlier periods paid later (on gross basis where applicable).
4. Compare with interest paid.
expected_result: Interest fully paid.
exception_conditions: Interest unpaid or short-paid.
exposure_basis: Unpaid interest u/s 50(1) recoverable directly.
corrective_action: Pay interest through DRC-03.

title: Interest u/s 50(3) on wrongly availed and utilised ITC (Rule 88B)
objective: Quantify interest on ITC wrongly availed and utilised, applying the Rule 88B utilisation test.
procedure:
1. Identify ITC reversals relating to wrongly availed credit.
2. Determine whether and when the electronic credit ledger balance fell below the wrongly availed amount (head-wise, considering IGST/CGST/SGST cross-utilisation).
3. Compute interest from date of utilisation to date of reversal @ 18% p.a.
4. Compare with interest paid.
expected_result: Interest paid only where ITC utilised, correctly computed.
exception_conditions: Interest not paid on utilised credit; interest overpaid where balance remained sufficient.
exposure_basis: Interest u/s 50(3); potential refund of interest overpaid.
corrective_action: Pay or claim refund of interest as applicable.

title: Late fee on returns
objective: Verify late fee computation and payment for delayed returns, considering notified waivers and caps.
procedure:
1. List delayed returns.
2. Recompute late fee applying notified caps and waivers.
3. Compare with amounts paid.
expected_result: Correct late fee paid.
exception_conditions: Late fee unpaid on GSTR-1/GSTR-9.
exposure_basis: Late fee u/s 47 recoverable.
corrective_action: Pay late fee shortfall.

title: Limitation tracker for demand exposure by financial year
objective: Maintain a limitation tracker for each FY under Sections 73, 74 and 74A, so that exposure and defence strategies reflect time-bar positions.
procedure:
1. For each FY, identify the due date of the annual return (and any extensions).
2. For FY up to 2023-24, compute last dates for SCN (Section 73: three months before the three-year order limit; Section 74: six months before the five-year order limit).
3. For FY 2024-25 onwards, compute notice limit under Section 74A (42 months from due date of annual return).
4. Map open audit observations to FYs and flag those approaching time-bar.
expected_result: Tracker maintained and used in risk assessment.
exception_conditions: Exposure quantified for time-barred years; notices received beyond limitation not challenged.
exposure_basis: Determines whether quantified exposures in other controls remain enforceable.
corrective_action: Update tracker annually and challenge time-barred notices.

title: Section 128A waiver eligibility for FY 2017-18 to 2019-20
objective: Identify demands for FY 2017-18 to 2019-20 under Section 73 eligible for waiver of interest and penalty on payment of tax, and ensure conditions are met.
procedure:
1. List notices/orders for FY 2017-18 to 2019-20 under Section 73.
2. Verify payment of full tax demanded by the notified date and filing of waiver application in the prescribed form.
3. Verify withdrawal of appeals where required.
expected_result: Eligible cases availed waiver.
exception_conditions: Eligible cases missed; partial payment; Section 74 cases mistakenly included.
exposure_basis: Interest and penalty saved/forgone.
corrective_action: Complete waiver procedures or document reasons for not availing.

title: Voluntary payment before notice to avoid penalty
objective: Ensure audit-identified liabilities for pre-2024-25 periods are paid with interest before SCN under Section 73(5), and for later periods under Section 74A provisions, to minimise penalty.
procedure:
1. List audit observations quantified as payable.
2. Verify DRC-03 payment with interest and intimation to the officer.
3. Track acknowledgement and closure.
expected_result: Timely voluntary payments with interest.
exception_conditions: Payments without interest; no intimation.
exposure_basis: Penalty avoided if paid before notice (non-fraud).
corrective_action: Pay with interest and file intimation.

title: Completeness of notice and order register
objective: Ensure every notice, intimation and order issued on the GST portal (including the 'Additional Notices and Orders' tab), by e-mail or physically is captured, assigned and tracked to closure.
procedure:
1. For each GSTIN, review the portal 'Notices and Orders', 'Additional Notices and Orders' and 'View Additional Notices' sections, and the registered e-mail inbox, for the audit period and up to the audit date.
2. Compile a master list with reference number, form (ASMT-10, ADT-01, DRC-01A, DRC-01, DRC-07, REG-17, RFD-08 etc.), period, amount, issue date and due date.
3. Compare with the internal litigation/notice register and identify omissions.
4. Identify any ex parte orders (DRC-07) and the reason (non-receipt, non-response).
5. Confirm that the electronic liability register Part II reflects confirmed demands.
expected_result: Internal register is complete and every item has an owner, due date and status.
exception_conditions: Notices under 'Additional Notices' not monitored; ex parte orders; demands in Part II not in register.
exposure_basis: Ex parte confirmation of tax + interest + penalty; loss of appeal window u/s 107 if communication date missed; recovery proceedings.
corrective_action: Update register, assign owners, seek rectification/appeal for ex parte orders, and institute weekly portal monitoring with escalation.

title: ASMT-10 scrutiny notices — reconciliation-based responses
objective: Ensure discrepancies communicated in ASMT-10 are answered in ASMT-11 within time with reconciliations, and that accepted liabilities are paid with interest.
procedure:
1. List ASMT-10 notices and categorise discrepancies (GSTR-1 vs 3B, 2A/2B vs 3B ITC, e-way bill vs returns, RCM, TDS/TCS).
2. For each, prepare a reconciliation linking to the relevant control results (B-OUT-002, C-ITC-001, G-EWB-001).
3. Verify ASMT-11 filed within the time allowed and payment via DRC-03 for admitted amounts.
4. Track whether ASMT-12 (closure) has been issued or the matter has escalated to SCN.
expected_result: All scrutiny notices answered with reconciliations; admitted amounts paid with interest.
exception_conditions: No reply; generic replies without reconciliation; admitted amounts unpaid.
exposure_basis: Escalation to SCN u/s 73/74/74A with tax, interest and penalty.
corrective_action: File comprehensive replies, pay admitted dues with interest, and seek closure orders.

title: Departmental audit (Section 65) readiness, para tracking and closure
objective: Ensure the entity is audit-ready and that audit paras are tracked from ADT-01 through ADT-02 and any resulting SCN.
procedure:
1. List ADT-01 notices, periods covered and documents requested.
2. Prepare standard audit pack: financial statements, GSTR-9/9C, reconciliations, ITC registers, RCM workings, export/refund files.
3. Track each para: accepted and paid (DRC-03 with interest), contested with written submission, or pending.
4. Verify ADT-02 issued and whether SCN followed for contested paras within limitation.
expected_result: Audits closed with documented positions; accepted paras paid with interest.
exception_conditions: Paras accepted without technical review; payments without interest; contested paras without submissions.
exposure_basis: Tax + interest on accepted paras; contested paras become SCN exposure.
corrective_action: Maintain a standard audit pack and para tracker; obtain technical review before accepting paras.

title: SCN replies including section, limitation and procedural defences
objective: Ensure SCNs are answered on merits and on jurisdictional grounds: correct section for the period (73/74 for FY up to 2023-24; 74A for FY 2024-25 onwards), limitation, pre-SCN consultation, and quantification.
procedure:
1. For each SCN, verify the provision invoked matches the financial year and nature of allegation.
2. Verify the notice was issued within limitation computed from the due date of the annual return (see O-LIM-004) and that invocation of extended period (Section 74) is supported by specific allegations of fraud/suppression.
3. Verify DRC-01A/pre-SCN consultation where applicable and that the demand does not exceed the notice.
4. Prepare reply (DRC-06) on merits with documentary support; request personal hearing under Section 75(4).
5. Evaluate option of payment within 30 days of SCN (reduced penalty) for weak positions.
expected_result: Timely, complete replies covering jurisdiction, limitation and merits.
exception_conditions: Reply not filed; wrong section unchallenged; extended period accepted without contest.
exposure_basis: Tax + interest + penalty as proposed in SCN (100% penalty in fraud cases).
corrective_action: File replies within time, attend hearings, and settle weak issues early to minimise penalty.

title: Appeal timelines and mandatory pre-deposit
objective: Ensure appeals against adverse orders are filed within three months of communication (plus condonable one month) with correct pre-deposit.
procedure:
1. List all adverse orders (DRC-07, RFD-06 rejections, REG cancellations) with date of communication.
2. Compute appeal due dates and condonation window.
3. Verify pre-deposit (admitted tax + 10% of disputed tax, within statutory cap) paid and linked to the appeal (APL-01).
4. Confirm stay of recovery and that the liability register reflects the stay.
5. Track hearing dates and outcomes, and the availability of the Appellate Tribunal for second appeals.
expected_result: All appeals filed in time with pre-deposit; recoveries stayed.
exception_conditions: Time-barred appeals; pre-deposit paid but not linked; recovery initiated despite appeal.
exposure_basis: Order becomes final; recovery of full demand including interest and penalty.
corrective_action: File appeals immediately, link pre-deposits, and request recovery stay updates on portal.

title: DRC-01B (GSTR-1 vs 3B) and DRC-01C (2B vs 3B) intimations
objective: Ensure system-generated intimations are answered or settled within the prescribed time to avoid GSTR-1 blocking and escalation.
procedure:
1. List DRC-01B and DRC-01C intimations by period and amount.
2. Map each to reconciliation results from B-OUT-002 and C-ITC-001.
3. Verify Part B response (payment via DRC-03 or explanation) filed within the prescribed time.
4. Check whether GSTR-1 filing was blocked and the impact on customers.
expected_result: All intimations answered timely with reconciliations or payments.
exception_conditions: Unanswered intimations; GSTR-1 blocked; explanation inconsistent with books.
exposure_basis: Liability/ITC differences with interest; potential demand proceedings; customer ITC delays.
corrective_action: File responses, pay accepted differences with interest, and run monthly pre-filing comparisons.

title: GST TDS credits (GSTR-7) — acceptance and receivable reconciliation
objective: Ensure GST TDS deducted by Government departments, PSUs and notified deductors is accepted on the portal, credited to the cash ledger and reconciled with customer receivables.
procedure:
1. Download TDS/TCS credit received statements for each period.
2. Reconcile TDS amounts with customer receipts and short-payments in receivables (2% of taxable value where contract exceeds Rs 2.5 lakh).
3. Verify acceptance of TDS credits and corresponding credit in the electronic cash ledger.
4. Identify deductors who deducted but did not file GSTR-7, or reported wrong GSTIN/value.
5. Ensure TDS receivable GL is cleared on acceptance.
expected_result: All TDS credits accepted and reconciled; no stale TDS receivable balances.
exception_conditions: Credits pending acceptance; deductions in books without portal credit; wrong deductee GSTIN.
exposure_basis: Loss of cash ledger credit and receivable write-off risk equal to unreconciled TDS.
corrective_action: Accept credits, pursue deductors for corrections, and clear GL balances.

title: E-commerce TCS (GSTR-8) reconciliation with marketplace sales
objective: Reconcile marketplace sales, returns and TCS credits reported by e-commerce operators with GSTR-1 and books.
procedure:
1. Obtain marketplace settlement reports and TCS statements for each ECO and GSTIN (including fulfilment-centre States).
2. Reconcile net taxable value per ECO (GSTR-8) with sales net of returns per books and GSTR-1 (Table 14 supplies through ECO).
3. Investigate differences: returns timing, cancelled orders, State mapping of fulfilment centres.
4. Accept TCS credits and reconcile with receivable from ECO.
expected_result: ECO-reported values reconcile with GSTR-1; TCS credits accepted.
exception_conditions: ECO values exceed GSTR-1 (under-reporting risk); sales in States where seller is not registered.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings. Unregistered-State sales create registration exposure.
corrective_action: Correct GSTR-1, pay differential tax with interest, register in fulfilment States, and reconcile monthly.

title: Section 9(5) supplies — ECO liability and supplier reporting
objective: Ensure notified services supplied through ECOs (restaurant, passenger transport, accommodation, housekeeping) are taxed by the ECO and not double-taxed or omitted.
procedure:
1. Identify revenue streams through ECOs and determine whether they fall under Section 9(5).
2. For 9(5) supplies, verify the supplier does not pay tax and reports value in the designated tables (GSTR-1 Table 14/GSTR-3B 3.1.1 as applicable).
3. Where the company is the ECO, verify tax paid in cash on 9(5) supplies.
expected_result: Correct liability allocation and reporting.
exception_conditions: Tax paid by both supplier and ECO; 9(5) supplies omitted.
exposure_basis: Excess tax paid (refund subject to unjust enrichment) or short-paid tax + interest by ECO.
corrective_action: Correct reporting and coordinate with ECO.

title: Works contract — classification, rate and ITC on own construction
objective: Verify classification of composite supplies involving immovable property as works contract, the rate entry applied, and that ITC on construction of own immovable property is not claimed.
procedure:
1. Identify outward contracts involving construction, installation or erection that result in immovable property.
2. Verify the rate entry (including concessional entries for specified recipients) and supporting certificates.
3. Identify inward works contract services and goods used for construction of own immovable property and verify ITC reversal under Section 17(5)(c)/(d).
4. Distinguish plant and machinery installations (eligible) from civil structures (blocked).
expected_result: Correct classification and rates; ITC blocked on own construction.
exception_conditions: Concessional rate without eligibility evidence; ITC claimed on building construction.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings. ITC reversal + interest on blocked construction credit.
corrective_action: Correct rates and invoices, reverse blocked ITC, and document plant and machinery positions.

title: Section 15 inclusions — freight, packing, subsidies and late-payment interest
objective: Ensure mandatory inclusions in transaction value under Section 15(2) are taxed at the rate of the principal supply.
procedure:
1. Identify separately recovered charges (freight, packing, insurance, installation, tooling) and verify they are part of taxable value.
2. Identify interest/late fee/penalty recovered from customers for delayed payment and verify tax paid.
3. Identify subsidies linked to price from non-Government sources.
4. Identify tooling/moulds supplied by customers free of cost (amortisation inclusion analysis).
expected_result: All inclusions taxed.
exception_conditions: Late-payment interest recovered without tax; freight recovered through debit notes without GST.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Pay tax with interest and configure billing to include ancillary charges in taxable value.

title: Valuation of domestic supplies to related parties
objective: Verify valuation of supplies to related persons and distinct persons under Rule 28, particularly where the recipient is not eligible for full ITC.
procedure:
1. Identify related-party customers (Section 15 Explanation) from the related-party register.
2. Compare prices with those charged to unrelated customers for like goods/services.
3. Where the recipient is fully ITC-eligible, document reliance on the second proviso to Rule 28.
4. Where the recipient has exempt/blocked use, verify OMV or cost-plus valuation.
expected_result: Defensible valuation documented for all related-party supplies.
exception_conditions: Concessional pricing to related parties making exempt supplies; no valuation note.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings.
corrective_action: Pay differential tax with interest and maintain a valuation policy.

title: Transfer of business, slump sale and transfer of ITC (ITC-02)
objective: Ensure business transfers are correctly characterised (exempt transfer of going concern vs taxable asset sale) and unutilised ITC is transferred through ITC-02.
procedure:
1. Review business transfer agreement/scheme for transfer of business as a going concern (assets, liabilities, employees, contracts) vs itemised asset sale.
2. Where going concern, verify exemption applied and documentation.
3. Where itemised sale, verify tax on each asset including Section 18(6) computation.
4. Verify ITC-02 filed by transferor with CA/CMA certificate and accepted by transferee; verify apportionment where partial transfer (demerger) by asset value.
5. Verify registration actions (transferee registration, transferor cancellation/amendment).
expected_result: Correct characterisation and ITC transfer.
exception_conditions: Itemised asset sale claimed as going concern; ITC-02 not filed; ITC transferred without accepted ITC-02.
exposure_basis: Short-paid output tax + interest u/s 50(1) @ 18% p.a. from the due date of the GSTR-3B of the original period to date of payment; penalty u/s 73/74 (periods up to FY 2023-24) or u/s 74A (FY 2024-25 onwards) if raised in proceedings. Loss of transferable ITC.
corrective_action: File ITC-02, pay tax where transfer is not a going concern, and update registrations.

title: Refund limitation tracker across categories
objective: Track two-year limitation for all refund categories (zero-rated, inverted duty, excess cash, wrong head, deemed export, appeal outcomes).
procedure:
1. List refund-eligible periods and amounts by category.
2. Compute relevant date for each (e.g., due date of return for ITC refunds; date of payment for wrong head; date of appellate order).
3. Flag periods within six months of limitation and those already time-barred.
4. Verify claims filed and status (RFD-02/03/04/06).
expected_result: No refunds lapse.
exception_conditions: Refunds lapsing; deficiency memos not responded to.
exposure_basis: Lost refund (time-barred) amount.
corrective_action: File claims before limitation and respond to deficiency memos promptly.

title: Vendor threshold monitoring and composition vendors charging tax
objective: Monitor unregistered vendors whose supplies to the company indicate they have crossed registration thresholds, and composition vendors who charge GST on invoices.
procedure:
1. Compute cumulative purchases per unregistered vendor (PAN-based) in the financial year.
2. Flag vendors whose supplies to the company alone exceed the Section 22 threshold and request registration status.
3. Identify composition vendors (taxpayer type) whose invoices show GST and on which ITC was claimed.
4. Identify vendors charging GST without registration (no GSTIN or invalid GSTIN).
expected_result: Vendor base compliant; no ITC from composition or unregistered vendors.
exception_conditions: ITC on composition-vendor invoices; GST paid to unregistered vendors.
exposure_basis: Ineligible/excess ITC to be reversed + interest u/s 50(3) @ 18% p.a. only to the extent the credit was utilised (Rule 88B); penalty exposure u/s 73/74/74A. Tax paid to unregistered vendors is a recoverable (G bucket).
corrective_action: Reverse ineligible ITC, recover tax wrongly charged, and require GST status validation at vendor onboarding.

title: New places of business, project sites and third-party fulfilment warehouses
objective: Ensure new places of business opened during the period (project sites, fulfilment centres, warehouses) are registered or added before operations commence.
procedure:
1. Identify new sites from capex, lease, project contracts and ECO fulfilment-centre reports.
2. Compare commencement dates with registration/amendment dates.
3. Review e-way bill destinations/dispatch points for undeclared locations.
4. Assess State-level registration requirements for project sites in new States.
expected_result: All new sites registered before operations.
exception_conditions: Operations or stock at unregistered locations; supplies from a State without registration.
exposure_basis: Penalty u/s 122/125; tax on supplies made without registration + interest; ITC risk on goods received at unregistered premises.
corrective_action: Register or add sites, and require tax sign-off in site-opening checklist.

title: Record retention and electronic records
objective: Ensure accounts and records are retained for 72 months from the due date of the annual return (longer where proceedings are pending) and electronic records are backed up and retrievable.
procedure:
1. Review document retention policy against Section 36 requirements.
2. Identify the oldest open financial year (considering pending proceedings and limitation).
3. Test retrieval of a sample of invoices, e-way bills, contracts and reconciliations for that year.
4. Verify backup and access controls over electronic records, including ERP migrations.
expected_result: Records for all open years retrievable.
exception_conditions: Records lost on ERP migration; vendor invoices not retrievable for open years.
exposure_basis: Inability to substantiate ITC (burden on taxpayer u/s 155) leading to disallowance; penalty for non-maintenance.
corrective_action: Update retention policy and archive data from legacy systems.

title: Expatriate secondment and overseas manpower arrangements
objective: Evaluate RCM on secondment arrangements where an overseas group entity seconds employees and the Indian entity reimburses salary costs.
procedure:
1. Identify seconded employees from payroll/HR records and intercompany reimbursements.
2. Review secondment agreements for control, employer of record, and reimbursement terms.
3. Apply the Northern Operating Systems principles to determine whether a supply of manpower by the overseas entity exists.
4. Compute IGST RCM on reimbursements (value per invoice where fully ITC-eligible per Circular 210/4/2024-GST) and verify payment and ITC.
5. Consider limitation and any pending notices on the issue.
expected_result: RCM evaluated and paid where applicable.
exception_conditions: Salary reimbursements to overseas entity without RCM.
exposure_basis: IGST RCM + interest u/s 50(1); ITC generally available, so cash-flow/interest exposure primarily.
corrective_action: Pay RCM with interest and claim ITC; restructure secondment documentation.
